title: Feasibility-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for O-CU and O-DU Mapping in 6G O-RAN
abstract: arXiv:2611.34516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies the mapping of the virtual network function components (VNFCs) of the O-RAN central unit (O-CU) and O-RAN distributed unit (O-DU) onto virtual machines (VMs) in sixth-generation (6G) open radio access networks (O-RAN). The problem is formulated as a feasibility-aware sequential decision process that maximizes the number of placed VNFCs and, secondarily, favors fewer active VMs and lower residual resource wastage. Although conventional optimization techniques can solve this problem, their computational cost becomes prohibitive for larger instances or when optimization must be repeated. To address this limitation, we explore two neural reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods: a deep $Q$-network (DQN) and a double deep $Q$-network (Double DQN). Whereas DQN uses the same target network to both select and evaluate the bootstrap action, Double DQN decouples these two operations to mitigate maximization-induced overestima

translated_title: 面向6G O-RAN中O-CU与O-DU映射的可行性感知深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究在第六代（6G）开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中，将O-RAN中央单元（O-CU）和O-RAN分布式单元（O-DU）的虚拟网络功能组件（VNFC）映射到虚拟机（VM）上的问题。该问题被建模为一个可行性感知的序贯决策过程，其首要目标是最大化已部署的VNFC数量，其次是偏好更少的活跃虚拟机数量和更低的剩余资源浪费。尽管传统优化技术可以解决该问题，但在更大规模实例或需要重复执行优化时，其计算成本会变得难以承受。为解决这一局限，本文探索了两种基于神经强化学习（RL）的方法：深度Q网络（DQN）和双深度Q网络。DQN使用同一个目标网络来选择和评估自举动作，而Double DQN则将这两个操作解耦，以缓解由最大化操作引起的过估计问题。
tldr: 本文提出一种可行性感知的深度强化学习方法，利用DQN和Double DQN将6G O-RAN中O-CU和O-DU的虚拟网络功能组件高效映射到虚拟机上，在保证可行性的同时显著降低传统优化方法的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a feasibility-aware deep reinforcement learning approach using DQN and Double DQN to efficiently map O-CU and O-DU VNFCs onto virtual machines in 6G O-RAN, significantly reducing computational cost while ensuring feasibility.
